description: This file defines an immutable data object class 'SavingsAccountSummaryData' used to encapsulate summary information about a savings account, including methods to update and calculate various financial metrics such as deposits, withdrawals, interest earned, and account balances.

classes.name: SavingsAccountSummaryData
classes.description: Immutable class representing a summary of a savings account, including financial metrics and methods to update them based on transactions and interest periods.

methods.name: SavingsAccountSummaryData
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the summary data with key financial metrics and account information.

methods.name: setPrevInterestPostedTillDate
methods.description: Sets the previous interest posted till date.

methods.name: getRunningBalanceOnPivotDate
methods.description: Returns the current running balance on the specified pivot date.

methods.name: updateSummaryWithPivotConfig
methods.description: Updates the summary data with new transaction details, adjusting totals and account balance accordingly.

methods.name: updateFromInterestPeriodSummaries
methods.description: Updates interest-related fields based on a list of interest posting periods.

methods.name: updateRunningBalanceAndPivotDate
methods.description: Calculates and updates the running balance and interest posting date based on transactions.

methods.name: updateSummary
methods.description: Recalculates and updates all summary metrics based on a list of transactions.

methods.name: setRunningBalanceOnPivotDate
methods.description: Sets the running balance for a specific pivot date.

methods.name: setInterestPostedTillDate
methods.description: Sets the date till which interest has been posted.
